title: India Analytics Data Export Policy

sections.text: Analytics department in India may share Dataset Y with pre-approved domestic vendors.

metadata.scanner_note: This RULE potentially conflicts with DS-001-v5-S3 which requires CDO approval for ALL Analytics Dataset Y sharing to external vendors. A pre-approval process is not equivalent to CDO express written approval.

source: Analytics India Regional Office — Data Export Policy v1.0 (CONFLICT DOCUMENT — for policy scanner testing)
